name: syndroo
description: Open-source publishing infrastructure for the social web.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @syndroo/core && npm run build --workspace @syndroo/bluesky
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run check --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @syndroo/core && npm run test --workspace @syndroo/bluesky && npm run test --workspace @syndroo/cloudflare-worker
